answer.says: Ramesh ji, the sun is still high and the air is thick. I will rest here for a while. Please bring me a glass of water when you pass.
answer.thought: The haze is too dense for a walk, and the study has worn me out. I shall sit on the verandah and let the afternoon pass; the file is in the hands of the state, and I cannot force it to move. Rest is not idleness; it is the withdrawal of the spirit into itself to gather strength for the next act.
